title: User prompt (aperiodic-articulation-cell variant, codomain of prompting)
description: The cell produced by prompting acting on an utterance with human-typing enactor metadata. Carries the input utterance, the enactor identity (which human supplied the utterance), and the transaction time. Aperiodic-articulation-cell variant.

enactor.description: Identifier of the human enactor that supplied the utterance.

transactionTime.description: RFC 3339 datetime when the utterance was supplied.
